title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0036524238117 with the original 74 erasures (+0.0000003056025 over #7645)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction raises the conditional bound from **0.0036521182092** in #7645 to **0.0036524238117** on the same 17-call target and original 74 ordered erasures. The 226/990 courier lets role 226 travel directly from chart 719 to 127. The complete paid histogram changes by −17 at rank 1, −17 at rank 2 and +17 at rank 3. Strict subadditivity gives the improvement throughout the moment interval. The new invoice crosses at approximately 0.003652423811866665.

| Complete signed caller | #7645 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Paid positions | 110,298 | 110,281 |
| Productive positions | 22,461 | 22,461 |
| Ordinary-work upper bound | 782,645,968 | 782,629,172 |
| Scalar services upper bound | 43,945,504 | 43,946,048 |
| Elementary tape records upper bound | 25,439,878,624 | 25,436,979,648 |

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The `p104-side-correction` scope is refined to this one courier on #7645 head `8ee7e6869b57ce445dbebd1d720366eab1f8ca40`. Its decoded word is `6c52b2fba7c20343a50cb92ed4b997aa9921c78f212ac6428d13fff2bcd014cf`. The new word is `450c7e544efb5258c4b8b4858b49cbd7482d14f206cdda1a71833fc73343ac66`. #7647 covers the distinct 134/329 contact. The [coordination thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19693933) also records the failed two-role test on the larger, 234-lifetime #7641 proposal.

## Validation

Run on Linux with CPython 3.12 from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-original74-courier226
```

Two separate exact interpreters agree on all 1,501 public rows, 630 private/COPY observations and 74 erasures. A legal reordering keeps the entire invoice and every protected observation but changes 65 public rows. Direct native and signed runs took 544 and 446 seconds. They cover 2,959 native chart pairs, absolute phases for all 512 forward and adjoint columns on 64 affected pairs and five composed routes, 3,044 signed catalogue maps, 104 boundaries and 54 strict plus four functional outer checks. The separate CI prerequisite carries the five reviewed blobs from ToikY’s #7643 verbatim so the registered package and historical checks can both run. [Proof and literal edits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/944ca28a8caa7422ad50c634e3d9aeef7eca34eb/research/p104-original74-courier226/PROOF.md) · [Complete application receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/944ca28a8caa7422ad50c634e3d9aeef7eca34eb/research/p104-original74-courier226/evidence/FINAL.json)

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds introduced the courier in #7617 (`12f6626e194808fa38f473a3e84b2f81e169e3d3`) on SYLforge’s #7616 word with 113 lifetimes. This transfer builds on #7645, #7644 and #7611. The package preserves the original application and signed-caller authors’ notices. Clear1nsight prepared the transfer with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro reviewed the public algebra and suggested the equal-invoice ordering control.

## Open next questions

An independent reviewer can start with the read of old 473, the restore of 990 at 127 and the all-column phase receipt. The conditional claim inherits all-column/spectator validity, owned erasure, uniform compilation, precision and fixed tape, and analytic recovery. Maintainers decide admission.
